title: fix(rest)!: /meta list refuses a bracketed object key on views and a bracketed package key on the list and book tree
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9EdXbpw3tnxagrfuK2otRVU)_
Fixes #29199
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc page teaches a bracketed `object` or `package` key (`git grep` over `skills/`, `content/docs/` and `apps/docs/` finds none); the pages that name `?object=` and `?package=` teach the plain spelling, which is unchanged.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:视图列表 `GET /meta/view` 收到括号写法的 `object`(`?object[]=NAME`、`?object[0]=NAME`)时答 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` 并点名该键；`/meta` 列表与 book tree 收到括号写法的 `package`(`?package[]=ID`、`?package[0]=ID`)时同样答 400。以前这些键被忽略，返回全部视图或跨全部包的列表。
- **为什么改**:按 qs 风格序列化数组的客户端只想取一个对象的视图或一个包的内容，却拿回全部，还会当作它要的那一份来用；和 #29046 修好的 `?id[]=` 是同一类静默放宽。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `packages/rest`(列表链一步 + 两个读门入口的同一判定，两条传输共用)，`patch` 带 BREAKING 横幅；只影响发括号键的 API 调用方，`@objectstack/client` 与控制台都不发。所有写门本来就以未知参数拒收 `package[]`，本 PR 不改写行为。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`(`refuseBracketedListFilter`、`metaBracketedPackageRefusal` 与第 4 步的调用);`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts` 列表门入口新增的几行;`.changeset/29199-bracketed-object-package-refused.md`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts`,预期全绿，其中 `BRACKETED view object[…]` 与 `BRACKETED package` 用例断言 400。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

`?object[]=lead`, `?object[0]=lead`, `?package[]=ID` and `?package[0]=ID` reach the `/meta` doors under the key as spelled: every adapter hands query keys through unparsed (`readQuery` in `plugin-hono-server`, `readDispatchQuery` in `@objectstack/hono`). The view switcher reads `query.object` and the package binding reads `query.package`, so neither saw them, and the caller got every view, or the list across every package, with 200.

- `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`
  - #29046's `refuseBracketedAppIdFilter` becomes one helper keyed by parameter, `refuseBracketedListFilter(query, param, names, lists)`. Step 3 asks it for `id` on `app` and step 4 now asks it for `object` on `view`. The `id` answer is byte-identical; the sentence builder is now `listFilterRefusalMessage`, and the empty `?id=` / `?object=` messages are byte-identical too (their existing pins pass unchanged).
  - `object` (new): `Query parameter 'object[]' names no object; the 'object' filter takes exactly one object name, spelled ?object=NAME. The list was not served: a bracketed 'object' key is not a filter. Name one object, or leave the parameter out to list every view you can see.`
  - `metaBracketedPackageRefusal(door, query)` (new, module-level, not added to the package index): on the two arity doors that read `package` (the list and the book tree) a key that opens `package[` is refused as data, rule `bracketed-parameter`, in the same sentence frame. `metaQueryArityRefusal` asks it after the multiplicity rule, so the runtime dispatcher's list and tree get it with no runtime source change.
  - list: `Query parameter 'package[]' names no package; the 'package' filter takes exactly one package id, spelled ?package=ID. The list was not served: a bracketed 'package' key is not a filter. Name one package, or leave the parameter out to list across every package.` The tree says `The tree was not served` and `read the tree across every package`.
- `packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts` (list) and `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-routes.ts` (book tree): `RestServer`'s two doors ask the same decision right after `refuseRepeatedQueryParams`, before the binding is read, and write it in the nested envelope their arity gate writes.
- A bracketed key beside the plain one is refused on all three (two spellings of one filter).

**Measured: which doors does each seam serve (order item 2, 3).**

| Door | `?object[]=` | `?package[]=` on main | This PR |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/view`, `/meta/views` (list chain step 4) | 200, every view | 200, every package | 400 / 400 |
| `GET /meta/:type`, any other type | not read (like `?object=`) | 200, every package | unchanged / 400 |
| `GET /meta/book/:name/tree` | n/a | 200, every package | 400 |
| `GET /meta/:type/:name`, `/layers` | n/a | 400 unknown parameter (closed set) | unchanged |
| `PUT` / `DELETE /meta/:type/:name`, `POST …/publish` (write doors) | n/a | 400 unknown parameter (closed set), protocol never called | unchanged |
| `GET /meta/diagnostics` | n/a | 400 unknown parameter (closed set) | unchanged |

Step 4 is the only list step that reads `object`, keyed on the folded `view` (`views` is covered). The write doors were measured before any change (a scratch probe driving each `RestServer` route with `?package[]=`; the dispatcher's save and item read ask the same closed sets through `metaItemQueryRefusal`), so no write behaviour changes here. The order's "at the binding's one seam" could not be taken literally: `metaItemPackageBinding(raw)` receives the VALUE of `query.package`, which is `undefined` for a bracketed key, so it cannot see the key. The seam both transports ask before every arity-door read of `package` is the arity decision, which is where the refusal sits; `rest-server.ts` (the binding's home) is untouched.

**Producer census (order item 5).** `@objectstack/client` builds `?package=` with `URLSearchParams.set` (both `meta.getItems` surfaces) and sends no `object` on the list; the console (`ui/**`, read only) has no qs library and no bracketed `object`/`package` builder; no docs or skill example spells either key bracketed. No real producer sends them.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/meta-app-publish-gate.test.ts`: `it.each(['object[]', 'object[0]', 'object[name]'])` on `view` and `views` for three caller postures asserts 400, `code`, the full sentence and no list; a bracketed key beside a plain `object` is 400; controls: `?object=lead` switches, no `object` lists all, and a bracketed `object` key on `app` is not read (200).
- `packages/rest/src/meta-query-arity-doors.test.ts`: the decision as data for `package[]`, `package[0]`, `package[id]` on the list and the tree (beside a plain `package` too); a repeated plain `package` still answers the multiplicity sentence first; not judged on `_drafts`, `state` or `packages[`; `RestServer`'s list and tree answer the nested 400 and `getMetaItems` is never called; controls: the plain `package` still scopes, none reads every package.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/dispatcher-query-arity.test.ts`: the dispatcher's list and tree refuse `package[]` / `package[0]` with the same code and sentence before any read, and its list chain refuses `object[]`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`: probes `?object[]=lead`, `?object[0]=lead`, `?package[]=crm` on the list census (every type × caller, both transports), `?package[]=crm` on the item, tree and layers censuses; the "reference moves" test asserts `RestServer`'s 400 for `object[]` and `package[]`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/meta-read-doors-live.dogfood.test.ts` (booted showcase over Hono), appended `describe`: `/meta/view?object[]=` / `?object[0]=showcase_task` and `/meta/object?package[]=` / `?package[0]=com.example.showcase` answer 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming the key, no items, as the admin and as a member; controls: `?object=showcase_task` is that object's views and fewer than all, `?package=com.example.showcase` is narrower than no package.

No existing test was edited to pass; every hunk in a test file is an addition.

<details><summary>Red first on main (45e9b2f1)</summary>

The pins were committed before the fix (919e71ba) and run against main's source and dist:

- rest: `Tests 13 failed | 58 passed (71)` — the three `BRACKETED view object[…]` cases (`expected 200 to be 400`) and the ten bracketed-`package` cases. Every control passed.
- runtime: `Tests 6 failed | 1174 passed (1180)` — the five dispatcher cases and "the reference moves". The census rows stayed green, as expected: on main both transports gave the same unfiltered answer.
- dogfood: the reds are read off the ablation legs below (the same code as main for each arm).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: each refusal, put back, reds only its own pins</summary>

Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest build`, then `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` before reading any run.

1. **object arm.** The step-4 call `if (metaType === 'view') refuseBracketedListFilter(query, 'object', 'object', 'view');` replaced by a marker statement. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `894bc70c` → `aae79d48`; marker present in 2 built files. rest `3 failed | 32 passed (35)` (the three `object[…]` cases); runtime `2 failed | 1178 passed (1180)` (the dispatcher `object[]` case and the reference test); dogfood `2 failed | 17 passed (19)` (`/meta/view?object[]=` and `?object[0]=`).
2. **package arm.** `metaBracketedPackageRefusal`'s door check replaced by an unconditional `return undefined`. Anchor 1 → 0, blob `894bc70c` → `2a7a9483`; marker present in 2 built files. rest `10 failed | 26 passed (36)` (the ten bracketed-`package` cases); runtime `5 failed | 1175 passed (1180)` (the four dispatcher list/tree cases and the reference test); dogfood `2 failed | 17 passed (19)` (`/meta/object?package[]=` and `?package[0]=`).

Each restore: blob back to HEAD `894bc70c`, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuild exit 0, marker absent from all 6 built files, whole tree clean.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise.** Holds as the card states it, and wider: the bracketed `package` key also reads as "every package" on the list (every type) and on the book tree.
- **File surface vs the claim.** The claim named `meta-item-read-gate.ts` and, if `package[]` red, the binding's home (`rest-server.ts`). The fix lives in `meta-item-read-gate.ts` plus three-line door hand-offs in `meta-collection-routes.ts` and `meta-item-read-routes.ts`; `rest-server.ts` is untouched (see "Measured" for why the binding cannot see the key). The runtime parity and dispatcher arity tests gained pins; no runtime source changed.
- **Two dialects, as before.** The view `object[]` refusal is thrown inside the list chain after the per-caller gate, so `RestServer` writes the flat `{ error, code }` body #29046's `id[]` refusal writes. The `package[]` refusal is answered at the door entry, where `package` is read, so `RestServer` writes the nested `{ error: { code, message } }` its arity gate writes. Status and `code` are identical in both.
- **Same class, not fixed here (report for the seat).** `GET /meta/_drafts` reads `?packageId=` and `?type=` with no closed set, so a bracketed `packageId[]` or `type[]` very likely reads as every package or every type; `?preview[]=draft` on the list reads as no preview (the published list) and `?include[]=` as no inclusion. Not measured here; they are outside the card's keys.
